text: Being here, I feel anticipation and curiosity. The sterile, organized room behind the glass beckons with the promise of ideas exchanged—a stage for dialogue or creation. Then, immersed in the brightly colored R+D exhibit, surrounded by screens and text, I sense the pulse of innovation and collective inquiry. These spaces seem to encourage questioning, collaboration, and the urge to push boundaries. I am enveloped in an atmosphere of possibility and reflective excitement.
